C0330.title: Family of Five Caught Exploiting Mall Parking Perks Using Virtual Phone Numbers
C0330.summary: Starting in March 2024, Zang, his wife Xiao, and others used virtual phone numbers to register new memberships at multiple shopping malls in Shanghai, fraudulently obtaining free parking vouchers and reward points.
